internal.title: Kafka Consumer Lag Alert in Accounting Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:37 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered in the accounting service, indicating a backlog in processing Kafka messages. Diagnosis confirmed the backlog as the root cause. The mitigation involved disabling the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 11:57 UTC, which led to recovery as verified by normalized consumer lag metrics shortly after. The incident was resolved without further impact.

Timeline:
- 11:37: Alert received for high Kafka consumer lag.
- 11:57: Diagnosis confirmed queue backlog; mitigation action approved and executed.
- 11:57: Recovery verified with normalized lag metrics.

No customer-facing impact was detected during this incident.

external.title: Temporary Processing Delay in Accounting Service Resolved
external.body: On 2026-11-08, the accounting service experienced a temporary delay in processing messages, which was detected and resolved promptly. The issue was identified as a backlog in message processing and was mitigated quickly, restoring normal service operation. Customers should not have experienced any disruption during this time.
